observations.description: Original 3D cartoon animation in the same character style: neon night streets in Japan, a pachinko hall and a prize counter.
Information carried by in-scene signs ('PRIZE HALL', 'PRIZE COUNTER', 'THANK YOU', a 'GAMBLING: NONE' checklist).
Neon purple/blue night palette with warm interior light.
Captions show 1-2 words at a time in sentence case with punctuation kept; white heavy rounded sans-serif with a thin dark outline and soft shadow, centred just below the middle of the frame.
Explains a legal loophole and ends on an ironic image (police checklist: gambling none).
Hook is a single concrete paradox stated immediately: "Gambling is illegal in Japan, yet there's a gambling hall on almost every street."
Ends on a concrete payoff that resolves the hook, no call to action: "He slides the tokens through, a hand slides over cash, and on paper, nobody gambles."

categorical.hook_style: one-sentence concrete paradox (strange action, absurd consequence, or rule + contradiction), no intro
categorical.ending_style: concrete payoff image that resolves the hook, then the video stops (no CTA, no summary)
